details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install path, the working directory and the npm/node version, plus an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so imports of the real package do not fail. Only host and install metadata is collected; no environment variables, tokens, credential files or file contents are read or transmitted. The README describes the package as an authorized dependency-confusion test and credits a named security researcher.
